data.body:
[P1] Preserve completed-child replay during in-process resumes

A parallel/map branch can complete a child context with a large `ReplayChildren` result, then suspend on a wait while another branch remains running. When the coordinator resumes it within the same invocation, that child's terminal checkpoint has already marked its inner operations in `_parent_done`. This new check rejects those operations before their saved results can be read. `_branch_worker` reports ORPHANED, causing the coordinator to exit and checkpoint a successful parent with missing branch results. Allow saved checkpoint reads and legitimate `ReplayChildren` reconstruction through the orphan guard while retaining checks before new work and checkpoints. Add an integration test covering this same-invocation resume.
